abilities.name: Combat Prowess
abilities.description: You add +1 damage to one type of weapon attack of your choice: melee weapon attacks or ranged weapon attacks.

abilities.name: Expert Combatant
abilities.description: You are trained in a specific weapon attack of your choice, such as swords, axes, or bows; or in a broader category of attacks such as light bashing weapons, light bladed weapons, light ranged weapons, medium bashing weapons, medium bladed weapons, medium ranged weapons, and so on.

abilities.name: Slice and Step
abilities.description: You reposition your foe or yourself an immediate distance away, easing your attack on your next turn (whether against that foe or a different one).

abilities.name: Swing Through GM intrusions
abilities.description: Your sword chips or bends, reducing its damage by 1 until repaired. Your sword goes flying, landing a short distance away. Your foe deflects your attack, and you inflict a moderate wound on yourself.

system.description:
Un Type de Épées & Sorcellerie centré sur l'archétype combattant à l'épée, tout en laissant la place à l'histoire et aux capacités propres du personnage.

Genre : Fantasy. Sous-genre : Épées & Sorcellerie. Réserves principales : Puissance, Célérité.
